biography.text: Born in 1947 in Passaic. Martini earned a B.A. from Villanova University (1968) and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School–Newark (1972). His career included a state-court clerkship, county and federal prosecution, private practice, local elected office, service as a Passaic County freeholder, one term in the U.S. House of Representatives, and service on the Port Authority board. President George W. Bush appointed him in 2002.
